description: The Komodo Dragon (Varanus komodoensis) is a reptile indigenous to Indonesia. It inhabits tropical savanna and monsoon forests on komodo, rinca, flores, and gili motang islands.
habitat: tropical savanna and monsoon forests on komodo
funFacts: Can grow up to 3 meters (10 feet) long, making it the world's largest living lizard
They have venomous bites with anticoagulant compounds that prevent blood clotting
Listed as Endangered by IUCN with approximately 3,000 adults remaining in the wild
In Indonesian folklore, Komodo dragons are believed to be the reincarnation of ancient ancestors
They can eat up to 80% of their own body weight in a single meal and then not eat for weeks
habitatOld: Tropical savanna and monsoon forests on Komodo, Rinca, Flores, and Gili Motang islands
description_id: Komodo (Varanus komodoensis) adalah reptil asli Indonesia. Ia mendiami sabana tropis dan hutan monsun di pulau Komodo, Rinca, Flores, dan Gili Motang.
funFacts_id: Dapat tumbuh hingga sepanjang 3 meter (10 kaki), menjadikannya kadal terbesar yang masih hidup di dunia
Gigitannya berbisa dengan senyawa antikoagulan yang mencegah pembekuan darah
Terdaftar sebagai Terancam Punah oleh IUCN dengan sekitar 3.000 dewasa yang tersisa di alam liar
Dalam cerita rakyat Indonesia, komodo dipercaya sebagai reinkarnasi nenek moyang zaman dahulu
Mereka bisa makan hingga 80% dari berat badannya dalam sekali makan dan kemudian tidak makan selama berminggu-minggu
habitat_id: sabana tropis dan hutan monsun di komodo

description: The Giant Panda (Ailuropoda melanoleuca) is a mammal indigenous to China. It inhabits temperate broadleaf and mixed forests in the mountains of central china.
habitat: temperate broadleaf and mixed forests in the mountains of central china
funFacts: Adults can weigh up to 135 kg (300 lbs) and spend 10–16 hours a day eating bamboo
Despite being classified as bears, pandas have a specialized wrist bone that functions as a pseudo-thumb for gripping bamboo
Downlisted from Endangered to Vulnerable in 2016 thanks to decades of conservation efforts by China
The giant panda has been a symbol of China's wildlife diplomacy since the 1970s, with 'panda diplomacy' gifting programs
Newborn pandas are about 1/900th the size of their mother, weighing only ~100 grams at birth
habitatOld: Temperate broadleaf and mixed forests in the mountains of central China
description_id: Panda Raksasa (Ailuropoda melanoleuca) adalah mamalia asli Tiongkok. Ia mendiami hutan berdaun lebar beriklim sedang dan hutan campuran di pegunungan Tiongkok tengah.
funFacts_id: Orang dewasa dapat memiliki berat hingga 135 kg (300 lbs) dan menghabiskan 10–16 jam sehari untuk makan bambu
Meski tergolong beruang, panda memiliki tulang pergelangan tangan khusus yang berfungsi sebagai ibu jari semu untuk menggenggam bambu
Diturunkan dari Terancam Punah menjadi Rentan pada tahun 2016 berkat upaya konservasi selama puluhan tahun oleh Tiongkok
Panda raksasa telah menjadi simbol diplomasi satwa liar Tiongkok sejak tahun 1970an, dengan program pemberian hadiah 'diplomasi panda'
Panda yang baru lahir berukuran sekitar 1/900 ukuran induknya, dan beratnya hanya ~100 gram saat lahir
habitat_id: hutan berdaun lebar dan hutan campuran di pegunungan di Cina tengah

description: The Japanese Macaque (Macaca fuscata) is a mammal indigenous to Japan. It inhabits broadleaf and evergreen forests, from subtropical lowlands to subalpine regions.
habitat: from subtropical lowlands to subalpine regions
funFacts: The northernmost-living non-human primate, found as far north as Shimokita Peninsula at lat 41°N
Famous for bathing in natural hot springs (onsen) during winter, a behavior first observed in 1963 at Jigokudani
They have complex social hierarchies with matrilineal rank inheritance — a mother's status passes to her offspring
In Japanese folklore, they are associated with the Shinto monkey deity Sarutahiko and the 'three wise monkeys'
They wash sweet potatoes in seawater to season them — a culturally transmitted behavior observed on Koshima Island
habitatOld: Broadleaf and evergreen forests, from subtropical lowlands to subalpine regions
description_id: Makaka Jepang (Macaca fuscata) adalah mamalia asli Jepang. Ia mendiami hutan berdaun lebar dan hutan hijau sepanjang tahun, dari dataran rendah subtropis hingga daerah subalpine.
funFacts_id: Primata non-manusia yang hidup paling utara, ditemukan di utara Semenanjung Shimokita pada garis lintang 41°LU
Terkenal karena mandi di sumber air panas alami (onsen) selama musim dingin, perilaku ini pertama kali diamati pada tahun 1963 di Jigokudani
Mereka memiliki hierarki sosial yang kompleks dengan pewarisan tingkat matrilineal — status seorang ibu diwariskan kepada keturunannya
Dalam cerita rakyat Jepang, mereka dikaitkan dengan dewa monyet Shinto Sarutahiko dan 'tiga monyet bijaksana'
Mereka mencuci ubi jalar dengan air laut untuk membumbuinya – sebuah perilaku yang diturunkan secara budaya dan diamati di Pulau Koshima
habitat_id: hutan berdaun lebar dan hijau sepanjang tahun

description: The Bengal Tiger (Panthera tigris tigris) is a mammal indigenous to India. It inhabits tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests, mangroves, and dry grasslands.
habitat: tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests
funFacts: The Bengal tiger is the most numerous tiger subspecies, making up about half of all wild tigers
Each tiger has a unique stripe pattern — like human fingerprints, no two are alike
India's Project Tiger, launched in 1973, helped increase populations from ~1,400 to over 3,000
The tiger is India's national animal and appears on the Reserve Bank of India's currency notes and emblems
A single tiger's territory can range from 20 to 1,000 km² depending on prey availability
habitatOld: Tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests, mangroves, and dry grasslands
description_id: Harimau Bengal (Panthera tigris tigris) adalah mamalia asli India. Ia mendiami hutan berdaun lebar lembab tropis dan subtropis, bakau, dan padang rumput kering.

Project Tiger India, diluncurkan pada tahun 1973, membantu meningkatkan populasi dari ~1.400 menjadi lebih dari 3.000
Harimau adalah hewan nasional India dan muncul di uang kertas dan lambang Reserve Bank of India
Wilayah seekor harimau bisa berkisar antara 20 hingga 1.000 km² tergantung ketersediaan mangsa

description: The Philippine Eagle (Pithecophaga jefferyi) is a bird indigenous to Philippines. It inhabits tropical moist forests on luzon, samar, leyte, and mindanao islands.
funFacts: With a wingspan of up to 2.2 meters (7 feet), it is considered the world's tallest eagle
Known locally as 'haribon' (bird king) or 'monkey-eating eagle' — though monkeys are only a small part of its diet
One of the rarest eagles on Earth, with fewer than 800 individuals estimated in the wild
Declared the national bird of the Philippines in 1995, replacing the maya bird
Mated pairs bond for life and only raise one chick every two years, making population recovery extremely slow
habitatOld: Tropical moist forests on Luzon, Samar, Leyte, and Mindanao islands
description_id: Elang Filipina (Pithecophaga jefferyi) adalah burung asli Filipina. Ia mendiami hutan tropis lembab di pulau Luzon, Samar, Leyte, dan Mindanao.
funFacts_id: Dengan lebar sayap hingga 2,2 meter (7 kaki), ia dianggap sebagai elang tertinggi di dunia
Dikenal secara lokal sebagai 'haribon' (raja burung) atau 'elang pemakan monyet' — meskipun monyet hanyalah sebagian kecil dari makanannya
Salah satu elang paling langka di Bumi, dengan perkiraan jumlah individu kurang dari 800 di alam liar
Dinyatakan sebagai burung nasional Filipina pada tahun 1995, menggantikan burung maya
Pasangan kawin terikat seumur hidup dan hanya membesarkan satu anak ayam setiap dua tahun, membuat pemulihan populasi menjadi sangat lambat

description: The Sri Lankan Elephant (Elephas maximus maximus) is a mammal indigenous to Sri Lanka. It inhabits tropical forests, grasslands, and scrublands in the lowland dry and wet zones.
habitat: and scrublands in the lowland dry and wet zones
funFacts: The Sri Lankan elephant is the largest of the three Asian elephant subspecies
Only about 6% of males develop tusks — the highest tuskless rate among Asian elephants
Listed as Endangered with habitat loss and human-elephant conflict being the primary threats
In Sri Lankan culture, elephants are sacred — the Temple of the Tooth in Kandy features an annual procession (Esala Perahera) with ornately decorated elephants
They play a crucial ecological role as 'ecosystem engineers,' creating clearings in dense forest that benefit other species
habitatOld: Tropical forests, grasslands, and scrublands in the lowland dry and wet zones
description_id: Gajah Sri Lanka (Elephas maximus maximus) adalah mamalia asli Sri Lanka. Ia mendiami hutan tropis, padang rumput, dan semak belukar di zona kering dan basah dataran rendah.
funFacts_id: Gajah Sri Lanka merupakan yang terbesar dari tiga subspesies gajah Asia
Hanya sekitar 6% gajah jantan yang mempunyai gading – tingkat tertinggi tanpa gading di antara gajah Asia
Terdaftar sebagai Terancam Punah dengan hilangnya habitat dan konflik manusia-gajah menjadi ancaman utama
Dalam budaya Sri Lanka, gajah dianggap suci — Kuil Gigi di Kandy menampilkan prosesi tahunan (Esala Perahera) dengan gajah yang dihias dengan penuh hiasan.
Mereka memainkan peran ekologis yang penting sebagai 'insinyur ekosistem', menciptakan pembukaan hutan lebat yang menguntungkan spesies lain

description: The Malayan Tapir (Tapirus indicus) is a mammal indigenous to Malaysia. It inhabits tropical lowland and hill forests of peninsular malaysia and sumatra.
habitat: tropical lowland and hill forests of peninsular malaysia and sumatra
funFacts: Adults have a distinctive black-and-white coloration — the white 'saddle' pattern helps camouflage them as a large rock in moonlit forests
They are the largest of the four tapir species and the only Old World tapir, with adults weighing 250–320 kg
Listed as Endangered due to habitat fragmentation from palm oil plantations and road networks
The Malayan tapir appears on the logo of the Malaysian Nature Society and features in regional folk art
They have a flexible, prehensile snout used like a short trunk to pluck leaves and fruit from branches
habitatOld: Tropical lowland and hill forests of Peninsular Malaysia and Sumatra
description_id: Tapir Malaya (Tapirus indicus) adalah mamalia asli Malaysia. Ia mendiami hutan dataran rendah dan perbukitan tropis di semenanjung malaysia dan sumatera.
funFacts_id: Burung dewasa mempunyai warna hitam-putih yang khas — pola 'pelana' putih membantu menyamarkan mereka sebagai batu besar di hutan yang diterangi cahaya bulan.
Mereka adalah yang terbesar dari empat spesies tapir dan satu-satunya tapir Dunia Lama, dengan berat dewasa 250–320 kg
Terdaftar sebagai Terancam Punah karena fragmentasi habitat dari perkebunan kelapa sawit dan jaringan jalan
Tapir Malaya muncul di logo Masyarakat Alam Malaysia dan ditampilkan dalam kesenian rakyat daerah
Mereka memiliki moncong yang fleksibel dan dapat dipegang yang digunakan seperti batang pendek untuk memetik daun dan buah dari dahan
habitat_id: hutan dataran rendah dan perbukitan tropis di semenanjung malaysia dan sumatra

description: The Asian Elephant (Elephas maximus) is a mammal indigenous to Thailand. It inhabits tropical and subtropical moist and dry forests, grasslands, and scrublands.
habitat: tropical and subtropical moist and dry forests
funFacts: Asian elephants have smaller ears and a more rounded body shape compared to their African cousins
Thailand's wild elephant population has declined dramatically from an estimated 300,000 a century ago
The elephant is Thailand's national symbol — 'Chang Thai' appears on historical royal flags and the Thai navy's ensign
They can consume up to 150 kg of vegetation and 200 liters of water per day
In Thai Buddhism, the white elephant (Chang Samkhan) is considered extremely auspicious and historically belonged only to the king
habitatOld: Tropical and subtropical moist and dry forests, grasslands, and scrublands
description_id: Gajah Asia (Elephas maximus) adalah mamalia asli Thailand. Ia mendiami hutan tropis dan subtropis lembab dan kering, padang rumput, dan semak belukar.
funFacts_id: Gajah Asia memiliki telinga yang lebih kecil dan bentuk tubuh yang lebih bulat dibandingkan gajah Afrika
Populasi gajah liar di Thailand telah menurun drastis dari perkiraan 300.000 pada abad lalu
Gajah adalah simbol nasional Thailand — 'Chang Thai' muncul di bendera kerajaan bersejarah dan panji angkatan laut Thailand
Mereka dapat mengkonsumsi hingga 150 kg tumbuhan dan 200 liter air per hari
Dalam Buddhisme Thailand, gajah putih (Chang Samkhan) dianggap sangat membawa keberuntungan dan secara historis hanya dimiliki oleh raja

description: The Saola (Pseudoryx nghetinhensis) is a mammal indigenous to Vietnam. It inhabits evergreen forests with little or no dry season in the annamite mountains.
habitat: evergreen forests with little or no dry season in the annamite mountains
funFacts: Dubbed the 'Asian unicorn,' the saola was only discovered by science in 1992 — one of the most recent large mammal discoveries
It is so elusive that it has only been documented in the wild a handful of times by camera traps since its discovery
The saola is not a true antelope or unicorn — it belongs to its own genus and is one of the most evolutionarily distinct mammals
Found only in the Annamite Mountains spanning the Vietnam-Laos border, it is a symbol of the region's extraordinary biodiversity
It is the only large mammal discovered in the last 50+ years, making it one of the greatest zoological finds of the 20th century
habitatOld: Evergreen forests with little or no dry season in the Annamite Mountains
description_id: Saola (Pseudoryx nghetinhensis) adalah mamalia asli Vietnam. Ia mendiami hutan hijau sepanjang tahun dengan sedikit atau tanpa musim kemarau di pegunungan annamite.
funFacts_id: Dijuluki 'unicorn Asia', saola baru ditemukan oleh sains pada tahun 1992 — salah satu penemuan mamalia besar terbaru.
Hewan ini sangat sulit ditangkap sehingga hanya didokumentasikan di alam liar beberapa kali melalui jebakan kamera sejak penemuannya
Saola bukanlah antelop atau unicorn sejati — ia termasuk dalam genusnya sendiri dan merupakan salah satu mamalia yang paling berbeda secara evolusi.
Hanya ditemukan di Pegunungan Annamite yang membentang di perbatasan Vietnam-Laos, ini adalah simbol keanekaragaman hayati yang luar biasa di kawasan ini.
Ini adalah satu-satunya mamalia besar yang ditemukan dalam 50+ tahun terakhir, menjadikannya salah satu penemuan zoologi terbesar di abad ke-20.

description: The Clouded Leopard (Neofelis nebulosa) is a mammal indigenous to Myanmar. It inhabits tropical and subtropical moist and dry forests, including mangrove swamps.
habitat: tropical and subtropical moist and dry forests
funFacts: Named for their distinctive cloud-like coat pattern, which provides perfect camouflage in dappled forest light
They have the longest canine teeth relative to body size of any wild cat — even longer than a tiger's proportionally
They are one of the most arboreal of all cats, capable of climbing down trees headfirst like a squirrel
In Myanmar, the clouded leopard inhabits the remote forests of Kachin and Shan states, areas rich in biodiversity
They can open their jaws to an extraordinary 100° — wider than any other cat species
habitatOld: Tropical and subtropical moist and dry forests, including mangrove swamps
description_id: Macan Dahan (Neofelis nebulosa) adalah mamalia asli Myanmar. Ia mendiami hutan tropis dan subtropis lembab dan kering, termasuk rawa bakau.
funFacts_id: Dinamakan demikian karena pola bulunya yang khas seperti awan, yang memberikan kamuflase sempurna dalam cahaya hutan belang-belang

Di Myanmar, macan tutul mendiami hutan terpencil di negara bagian Kachin dan Shan, kawasan yang kaya akan keanekaragaman hayati

description: The Proboscis Monkey (Nasalis larvatus) is a mammal indigenous to Brunei. It inhabits coastal mangrove forests, riverine forests, and lowland rainforest near water.
funFacts: Males have large, bulbous noses that can exceed 10 cm in length — the bigger the nose, the more attractive to females
They are the most accomplished swimmers of all primates, with partially webbed feet for leaping into water
Found primarily in Borneo's mangrove forests, Brunei's protected reserves are key to their survival
Known locally as 'bekantan' in Malay, the proboscis monkey is a beloved symbol of Borneo's wildlife
Their complex, multi-chambered stomachs allow them to digest toxic leaves that other animals cannot eat
habitatOld: Coastal mangrove forests, riverine forests, and lowland rainforest near water
description_id: Monyet Bekantan (Nasalis larvatus) adalah mamalia asli Brunei. Ia mendiami hutan bakau pesisir, hutan sungai, dan hutan hujan dataran rendah dekat perairan.
funFacts_id: Jantan mempunyai hidung besar dan bulat yang panjangnya bisa melebihi 10 cm — semakin besar hidungnya, semakin menarik bagi betina.
Mereka adalah perenang paling ulung di antara semua primata, dengan sebagian kaki berselaput untuk melompat ke dalam air
Ditemukan terutama di hutan bakau Kalimantan, cagar alam yang dilindungi di Brunei adalah kunci bagi kelangsungan hidup mereka

description: The Irrawaddy Dolphin (Orcaella brevirostris) is a mammal indigenous to Cambodia. It inhabits freshwater and brackish rivers, estuaries, and coastal areas.
funFacts: Unlike most dolphins, they lack a pronounced beak and have a rounded forehead — more closely related to killer whales than oceanic dolphins
The Mekong population between Cambodia and Laos is critically isolated with only about 92 individuals remaining
They can spit water to herd fish — a cooperative hunting technique rarely seen in other dolphin species
In Cambodian culture, the Irrawaddy dolphin is considered sacred and believed to bring good fortune to fishermen
They are among the few dolphin species that can survive in freshwater for their entire lives
habitatOld: Freshwater and brackish rivers, estuaries, and coastal areas
description_id: Lumba-lumba Irrawaddy (Orcaella brevirostris) adalah mamalia asli Kamboja. Ia mendiami sungai air tawar dan payau, muara, dan daerah pesisir.
funFacts_id: Tidak seperti kebanyakan lumba-lumba, mereka tidak memiliki paruh yang menonjol dan dahi yang membulat – lebih dekat kekerabatannya dengan paus pembunuh dibandingkan lumba-lumba samudera.
Populasi Mekong antara Kamboja dan Laos sangat terisolasi dan hanya tersisa sekitar 92 orang
Mereka dapat meludahkan air ke kawanan ikan – sebuah teknik berburu kooperatif yang jarang terlihat pada spesies lumba-lumba lainnya
Dalam budaya Kamboja, lumba-lumba Irrawaddy dianggap suci dan dipercaya membawa rejeki bagi para nelayan
Mereka adalah salah satu dari sedikit spesies lumba-lumba yang dapat bertahan hidup di air tawar sepanjang hidup mereka
habitat_id: sungai air tawar dan air payau

description: The Amur Leopard (Panthera pardus orientalis) is a mammal indigenous to North Korea. It inhabits temperate broadleaf and mixed forests in the korean peninsula and russian far east.
habitat: temperate broadleaf and mixed forests in the korean peninsula and russian far east
funFacts: The Amur leopard is the rarest big cat on Earth, with only about 100–120 individuals in the wild
They can run at speeds up to 60 km/h (37 mph) and leap more than 6 meters (19 feet) horizontally
Their beautiful rosette-spotted coat is thicker and longer than other leopard subspecies to withstand freezing temperatures
Historically found across the Korean Peninsula, they now survive primarily in a small region straddling the Russia-China-North Korea border
They can carry prey up to three times their own body weight up into trees
habitatOld: Temperate broadleaf and mixed forests in the Korean Peninsula and Russian Far East
description_id: Macan Tutul Amur (Panthera pardus orientalis) adalah mamalia asli Korea Utara. Ia mendiami hutan berdaun lebar dan hutan campuran di semenanjung Korea dan timur jauh Rusia.

Mereka dapat berlari dengan kecepatan hingga 60 km/jam (37 mph) dan melompat lebih dari 6 meter (19 kaki) secara horizontal

description: The Formosan Black Bear (Ursus thibetanus formosanus) is a mammal indigenous to Taiwan. It inhabits mountainous forests at elevations of 1,000–3,500 meters in taiwan's central ranges.
funFacts: The Formosan black bear is Taiwan's largest endemic land animal and is considered the island's national animal
They have a distinctive V-shaped white chest mark, leading to their Chinese name 'dog bear' (gǒuxióng)
Population has declined to an estimated 200–600 due to habitat loss and poaching for gall bladders used in traditional medicine
Taiwan's indigenous Tsou and Atayal people consider the bear a sacred animal in their cultural traditions
They are excellent climbers and often build nests in trees for resting and feeding
habitatOld: Mountainous forests at elevations of 1,000–3,500 meters in Taiwan's central ranges
description_id: Beruang Hitam Formosa (Ursus thibetanus formosanus) adalah mamalia asli Taiwan. Ia mendiami hutan pegunungan pada ketinggian 1.000–3.500 meter di wilayah tengah Taiwan.
funFacts_id: Beruang hitam Formosa adalah hewan darat endemik terbesar di Taiwan dan dianggap sebagai hewan nasional pulau tersebut
Mereka mempunyai tanda dada berwarna putih berbentuk V yang khas, yang menyebabkan nama Cina mereka 'anjing beruang' (gǒuxióng)
Populasinya telah menurun hingga sekitar 200–600 karena hilangnya habitat dan perburuan untuk mengambil kantung empedu yang digunakan dalam pengobatan tradisional.
Penduduk asli Taiwan Tsou dan Atayal menganggap beruang sebagai hewan suci dalam tradisi budaya mereka
Mereka adalah pemanjat ulung dan sering membangun sarang di pohon untuk beristirahat dan mencari makan

description: The Snow Leopard (Panthera uncia) is a mammal indigenous to Pakistan. It inhabits alpine and subalpine zones at 3,000–5,500 meters in the karakoram, hindu kush, and himalayas.
funFacts: Called the 'ghost of the mountains' for their elusive nature — they are almost never seen in the wild
Their 90 cm (3 ft) tail serves as a balancing aid on cliffs and a nose-warmer when sleeping
Snow leopards can leap up to 15 meters (50 feet) in a single bound across mountain crevasses
In Gilgit-Baltistan culture, the snow leopard is both revered and feared, often called 'shan' (ghost)
Pakistan is home to about 200–300 of the estimated 4,000–6,500 snow leopards remaining worldwide
habitatOld: Alpine and subalpine zones at 3,000–5,500 meters in the Karakoram, Hindu Kush, and Himalayas
description_id: Macan Tutul Salju (Panthera uncia) adalah mamalia asli Pakistan. Ia mendiami zona alpine dan subalpine pada ketinggian 3.000–5.500 meter di karakoram, hindu kush, dan himalaya.
funFacts_id: Disebut 'hantu pegunungan' karena sifatnya yang sulit dipahami — mereka hampir tidak pernah terlihat di alam liar
Ekornya yang berukuran 90 cm (3 kaki) berfungsi sebagai alat penyeimbang di tebing dan penghangat hidung saat tidur
Macan tutul salju dapat melompat hingga 15 meter (50 kaki) dalam sekali lompatan melintasi celah gunung
Dalam budaya Gilgit-Baltistan, macan tutul salju dihormati sekaligus ditakuti, sering disebut 'shan' (hantu)
Pakistan adalah rumah bagi sekitar 200–300 dari perkiraan 4.000–6.500 macan tutul salju yang tersisa di seluruh dunia

description: The Red Panda (Ailurus fulgens) is a mammal indigenous to Nepal. It inhabits temperate forests with bamboo understory at 2,200–4,800 meters in the eastern himalayas.

funFacts: Red pandas are not closely related to giant pandas — they belong to their own unique family Ailuridae

Nepal's red panda population, found primarily in the eastern hill forests, is declining due to habitat fragmentation
In Nepali folklore, red pandas are believed to be the protectors of the forest and bring good fortune
They spend most of their lives in trees and can descend headfirst thanks to rotating ankle joints
habitatOld: Temperate forests with bamboo understory at 2,200–4,800 meters in the eastern Himalayas
